text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that simulates future land use—including paddy fields—as an input to estimate potential rice yields under four climate scenarios. LULC prediction serves as a necessary intermediate step to inform the GAEZ-based yield modeling, satisfying core inclusion criteria partially but not meeting the “primary focus = LULC prediction” requirement. Thus, it falls under 'POSSIBLE'.)
